Accessing the Healing Power
of the Vagus Nerve
Two four-day Training Courses with

Stanley Rosenberg
Thor Philipsen, Judith Johnson

Los Angeles, CA
The evening of June 21 June 25

Black Mountain, NC
The evening ofJune 28-July 2

EFTA01063306

 The Course
In this course, healing practitioners will learn how to restore the physical
basis for mental and emotional well-being by working directly with a
client's nervous system. It will be highly participatory experiential, and
focused. This course isfor professional therapists and body workers.
As a participant, you will:
find yourself rethinking common psychological problems such as
=day, panic, phobias, borderlines, obsessive-compulsive disorder,
bipolar disorder, PTSD, autism, ADHD, and more, through an in-depth
understanding of Steven Porges's Polyvagal Theory.
increase your understanding of the vagus nerve in the relationship of
body, mind, and emotions.
acquire the ability to diagnose and track the functional state of the
nervous system.
learn to use simple exercises and hands-on techniques to regulate,
retune, and optimize the proper function of the vagus nerve and the
nervous system as a whole.
achieve greater physical and psychological well being through the power
of breath, touch, and movement.
This is a must-have, life-changing course for healing practitioners who
work with those suffering from nervous-system or emotional disorders
resistant to conventional treatment. The exercises and hands-on
techniques that you will learn move a person deeply on all levels. They can
be utilized by the practitioner on behalf of the client, or taught to the
client for self-help. You will find the exercises to be a powerful resource
and support in your current practice, whatever it may be.

EFTA01063307

 Topics covered will include:
• the cranial nerves and neuroception
• the polyvgal theory
• the social engagement theory
• how to optimize your breathing capacity
• hands-on techniques and exercises to instill the ventral vagal circuit
• and much more.
As a bonus, you will learn several natural face-lifting techniques, how to
smile naturally, and how to refine the quality of your voice—attributes that
make it easier for clients to feel safe with you and understand you more
easily.

EFTA01063308

 Who is Stanley Rosenberg?
Stanley Rosenberg has been a pioneer in the field of
body-mind therapies. He was one of the first craniosacral therapists, the first therapist trained as a Rolfer
in Denmark, and has trained with some of the greatest
osteopaths and energy practitioners of the last fifty
years. He has also developed his own unique methods
of face-lifting massage, breath training, and acting. He
developed applications of the Polyvagal Theory, and
has taught with Stephen Porges in Denmark and the
USA. He will be taking precious time away from his
professional work at the Stanley Rosenberg Institute in
Denmark to be with us.

For more about Stanley Rosenberg's work, see his book, Accessing the Healing Power of
the Magus Nerve: Self-Help Exercisesfor Anxiety Depression, Trauma, andI Autism, with
forewords by Stephen Porges and Benjamin Shield (North Atlantic Books,
December 2017).
